name: PA-16
label: Likely R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a PVI of R+11
Incumbent Mike Kelly has a large financial advantage
Challenger Wagner has raised only about $67,000
model.rationale: Kelly holds a heavily Republican seat, a roughly 20-to-1 fundraising edge, and markets give Wagner little chance, so the forecast stays close to the fundamentals-based margin of about R+15.
model.watch: A major outside spending surge or a district-wide polling surprise could narrow the race, but no evidence currently points that way.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Mike Kelly seeks another term in a northwestern Pennsylvania district that leans strongly Republican, with a partisan advantage of about eleven points. His challenger, Justin Wagner, has raised only about $67,000 and had roughly $38,000 on hand, while Kelly has raised nearly $1.2 million and holds over $1.3 million in cash. No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

Prediction markets give Kelly about a 92% chance of winning. With the incumbent's financial dominance, the district's lean, and no signs of outside investment in the challenger, the race sits as Likely Republican, though not fully out of reach in a strong Democratic wave.
